name: Awesome Hotel Booking
author: Abdullah Nahian

sections.description:
Take control of your hotel management with Awesome Hotel Booking – the lightweight and professional WordPress plugin that makes managing rooms, reservations, and bookings effortless. Designed for hotels, resorts, and guesthouses, it provides an intuitive admin dashboard, fast performance, and all the essential features you need to streamline your booking operations. Start saving time and improving guest experiences today!

Awesome Hotel Booking is a lightweight, SEO-friendly, and WordPress.org standards-compliant plugin specifically designed for hotels, resorts, and accommodation providers.

This plugin allows hotel owners and managers to efficiently manage rooms, reservations, and bookings—all from a simple and intuitive WordPress admin interface.

Key Features:
* Add, edit, and manage hotel rooms with detailed information.
* Create and manage bookings and reservations efficiently.
* Configure room types, occupancy limits, and custom booking options.
* Fully functional admin interface with tabs for Rooms, Bookings, and Settings.
* Translation-ready and compatible with any WordPress theme.
* Lightweight, fast, and optimized for performance.

Why Choose Awesome Hotel Booking?
* Simple & Powerful: Core hotel booking features without unnecessary complexity.
* Admin-Friendly: Manage all rooms and bookings directly from WordPress admin.
* SEO-Friendly: Built using WordPress coding standards and proper HTML structure.
* Flexible & Scalable: Perfect for small to medium-sized hotels, resorts, and guesthouses.
* Translation-Ready: Fully compatible with multilingual sites.

Ideal For:
Hotels, resorts, boutique hotels, guesthouses, and any accommodation provider needing a professional and easy-to-use booking system.

License

This plugin is licensed under the GPLv2 or later. See the LICENSE file for details.

Meta Description for SEO

Awesome Hotel Booking – Lightweight WordPress plugin to manage hotel rooms, reservations, and bookings easily. Ideal for hotels, resorts, and guesthouses.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the awesome-hotel-booking folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin via the Plugins menu in WordPress.
  3. Navigate to the Hotel Booking menu in the WordPress admin dashboard.
  4. Start adding rooms and managing bookings immediately!
sections.faq:
Can I use this plugin with any WordPress theme?

Yes! Awesome Hotel Booking works seamlessly with all WordPress themes since all functionality is handled in the admin area.

Can I customize room types and occupancy?

Absolutely! Use the Rooms Settings tab to configure default room types, occupancy limits, and other booking options.

Is this plugin translation-ready?

Yes! All text strings are wrapped in WordPress translation functions, and the text domain is awesome-hotel-booking.

Is this plugin lightweight and fast?

Yes! Designed to be minimal, optimized, and fast-loading without affecting site performance.
